purpose: Evaluate a complete pretrained word trigram probability on Sense's actual candidate strings, not an external pinyin engine or a small-corpus PMI residual.

model.reader: Existing extracted libime 1.0.11 static LanguageModel API; not current full libime engine

segmentation: Exact Viterbi within a bounded word graph: all model-known substrings of 1..8 Han plus unknown singleton fallback, input at most 26 Han including editor context. Merge only identical last-two vocabulary IDs and history length; no beam pruning. Start from null LM state and do not append EOS. Fixed deterministic byte-lexicographic word-path tie break. Score concatenated editor context plus candidate so words can cross the editor boundary. Output original LM log10 scores and chosen words.
eligibility: E55 first-eight equal-length Han BASE_EXACT/BASE_COMPOSED with explicit personal diagnostic provenance. Preserve entire order for any eligible personal path or any chosen path containing an unknown singleton. This is still host-only provenance and not a sufficient future runtime contract for exactly cancelling personal adjustments.
feature: For each eligible group center complete word LM log scores by that group's arithmetic mean, convert log10 to natural log and divide by sqrt(candidate Han length). Add a scalar-weighted 8*tanh residual to unchanged Sense baseline scores. No original coefficient changes, no candidate injection, no reference text or source-kind score adjustment.
fit: One scalar [0,4], CE plus ridge .001, zero initialization, L-BFGS-B maxiter 200 ftol 1e-10 gtol 1e-7. Use current-production E53 calibration groups after E55 provenance enrichment, minus explicit OOV-skipped groups. Freeze weight before opening the two known dev rankings. No alternate tokenizer, coefficient sweep or retry after failure.
gate: Native DP must match exhaustive toy enumeration and scores must match direct scoring of the chosen path. Each known dev domain top1/top5 nondecreasing, recall unchanged and character errors nonincreasing; combined top1 strictly higher. Report every gain/loss and full-sentence versus oracle midpoint separately. Additional native scoring plus host reorder P95 <=100ms. Check deterministic repeat outputs. A pass only permits broader regression and Android work, not automatic adoption.
dataBoundary: Upstream training overlap with evaluation/calibration sources is unknown; these are known diagnostic domains, not fresh/generalization proof. E14 source and distribution identities remain pinned. The current model-specific redistribution and training provenance require separate review before any APK packaging; old Debian copyright alone is not a new model's provenance proof.
scope: No production-source, Android-asset, UI, signing-key or physical-phone modification in this stage. Keep Sense front end, personalization and current release. Native scoring timing under WSL is not Android end-to-end timing.
